correctNoteNewFact.fact: The reform allowed householders to leave the rural commune and secure their allotment land as personal property; it also allowed consolidation into an otrub or separate khutor holding.
correctNoteNewFact.locator: PRlib retained full body L44-L48, especially L45. This source is an institutional historical summary, not the original decree.
correctNoteNewFact.whyAdditional: The prompt asks for the policy sphere; this note names a concrete mechanism of the agrarian reform beyond the label «крестьянского землевладения». It overlaps the explanation but does add that mechanism. The primary-text gap remains.
